verses.raw: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.<sup foot_note=255932>1</sup> And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
